## Official domains / entry points (manual verification only)

Use **live** pages for the student’s **catalog year**; do not copy requirement tables from search results or AI summaries into the article without checking the catalog.

- Northeastern academic catalog (program pages): `https://catalog.northeastern.edu/`
- Khoury College (programs, student-facing sections): `https://www.khoury.northeastern.edu/`
- Khoury undergraduate advising / academic policies hub (path may change): `https://www.khoury.northeastern.edu/current-undergraduate-students/` (confirm current subpaths on site)
- University Registrar (student records, policies): `https://registrar.northeastern.edu/`
